_doc: Creality Scan's mirror protocol (PC 1.4.3 'remote cast', JSON-RPC 2.0 over a WebRTC data channel): every
state key, scan setting, button, status, notification and dialog, as numbers with names and Creality Scan's
own English text (from its string table, 'loc_key'). Bundled as assets/mirror-protocol.json; the mirror
viewer uses it for labels. Source: Orbbec.Network enums in Creality Scan's IL2CPP metadata [O] and
resources.assets (English table) [O]. Which scan settings a scanner supports is not here: Creality Scan
sends that live (state key SupportedScanConfig) and per model it is in scanners.json (scan_options).
Wire formats: docs/mirroring in the dev repo; params of the bool/number commands are [value] [I].

phone_to_pc.scanCreate: no params; new scan with the settings applied (ScanState.CreateScan); ignored while a modal panel is open on the PC
phone_to_pc.scanStart: no params; start, or resume when paused
phone_to_pc.scan.setParams: {DicDatas:{<scan_params key>: value, ...}}, any subset; applied only while ScanParamsModifyRange is All (no scan created)

pc_to_phone.dialog: {DialogId, TitleType, TitleArgs, ContentType, ContentArgs, HasLeftButton, HasMiddleButton, HasRightButton, LeftButtonTextType, MiddleButtonTextType, RightButtonTextType, IsVisible, ClickedButtonType}

tips.0: Suitable for fast scanning. Supports geometry and texture tracking. Suitable for scanning human bodies, faces, sculptures, cultural relics, and similar objects.
tips.1: Suitable for high-precision detailed scanning. Supports tracking dark and reflective surfaces. Suitable for scanning industrial parts, complex molds, fine crafts, and similar objects.

tips.0: Detailed Face scan only. For Hair scan, please use Body mode.
tips.4: To scan a full body quickly. Able to scan hair directly without scanning spray.

tips.0: Fast Mode offers quicker scanning speed but with relatively less details.
tips.1: High-quality mode provides richer details, which may decrease frame rate.

tips.0:
Under Geometry mode, flat and regularly shaped objects may cause tracking loss while scanning. 
 If the object lacks rich texture features, It is recommended to use Marker mode after randomly placing circular markers on the surface.
tips.2:
Large: D ≥ 6mm, Medium&Small: D≥3mm
D: the inner diameter of the marking circle spot
Note: Please use non-reflective markers for marker mode.

tips.0: Standard FOV offers higher scanning accuracy, ideal for capturing fine details.
tips.1: Wide FOV covers a larger area, making it suitable for quickly scanning large objects or scenes.
